what_it_is: OrbitAID Aerospace is an Indian in-space servicing startup developing on-orbit refuelling and docking technology, publicly targeting India's first on-orbit refuelling mission and announcing docking/refuelling contracts. Its systems aim to extend satellite life and enable servicing economics for Indian constellations.
india_angle: OrbitAID announced India's first docking-and-refuelling contract (Maitri docking) and has been covered by space-industry networks as the front-runner for Indian on-orbit servicing - a capability area with clear dual-use defence interest.
intelligence_assessment: Contract announcements and incubator coverage are verifiable at claim level; mission execution is the real test. Watch for its first docking demonstration and any ISRO/IN-SPACe authorisations.

faq.a: On-orbit refuelling and docking systems to extend satellite life, targeting India's first on-orbit refuelling mission.
